profile.concavityEvidence: coarse visual estimate using available oblique product references
profile.profileEvidence: Individual local front and supporting profile/oblique source photos; visual proportions, not measured dimensions.
profile.profileObservation: Ten slender Y roots/twenty tips, numerous small inner apertures and thick black beadlock band; carbon/black detail retained.
profile.hardwareObservation: 60 rim heads in 2 individually checked row(s); photograph supports uniform spacing.
profile.finishObservation: Visual preview finish selected from the reviewed photograph; exposure/shadows are not used as a literal metal colour. Production finish is configurable.

notes: Five circular mounting bores and five rounded triangular hub windows individually measured from the ten native opaque-white components of BF2X. The oblique supporting image confirms actual apertures; no evenly spaced invented shape or hidden PCD was used. Original twenty main Y-spoke windows and outer silhouette remain alpha-traced.

recessedDetails.observation: Eighteen small closed outer beadlock rim pockets are visible in front and angle BF2X photos; the two top/bottom lettering pads remain flat and the black pocket floor is retained. Relief depth is a photograph-derived visual estimate.
